regions.merged_text: . Simplicity . .. unworldness. Charity .... Deus Caritas est et qui manet in Caritate in Deo manet et Deus in eo. . Impressive - Beautiful. Fraternal Charity ... "If a mother loves her son according to the flesh how much more diligently ought every one to love him who is his brother according to the spirit. WHY DID GOD MAKE YOU 2nd Q. in the old Catechism. God made me to know Him. O what a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure Rests in the same. It's Heaven begun, for the grateful, on Earth. To treasure aright !?!?!!!!!! Highest Heaven its worth. Fr. Sol.
